THIS PROJECT EXPLORES GENETIC AND ENVIRONMENTAL FACTORS CONTROLLING THE OCCURANCE OF HARMFUL ALGAL BLOOMS (HABS) IN IOWA'S LAKES. THE PROJECT WILL PRODUCE TOOLS AND DATABASES ACCESSIBLE AND USEFUL FOR STATE/LOCAL DECISION MAKERS AND MANAGERS DEALING WITH HABS.  THIS PROJECT IMPROVES MONITORING AND PREDICTIVE TOOLS TARGETING FUTURE CYANOTOXIN MONITORING AND MITIGATION EFFORTS. RESULTING RESEARCH AND TOOLS MAY BE APPLICABLE IN OTHER STATES. (PROVIDE CLEAN AND SAFE WATER, ENHANCE SHARED ACCOUNTABILITY, PRIORITIZE ROBUST SCIENCE).
positiveFlows.recipient: IOWA STATE UNIVERSITY OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY

positiveFlows.title: THE PROJECT IS DEVELOPING A WATERSHED CLASSIFICATION SYSTEM TO DIAGNOSE AND MANAGE HARMFUL ALGAL BLOOMS (HABS) IN THE UPPER OHIO RIVER BASIN. THE FOCUS OF THIS PROJECT IS TO DETERMINE CHARACTERISTICS RELATED TO DISTRIBUTION, DURATION, AND INTENSITY OF HABS AND DEVELOP A CLASSIFICATION SYSTEM TO PREDICT AND PREVENT HABS. THE SYSTEM PROVIDES A FRAMEWORK THAT CAN BE USED BY STATE AND LOCAL MANAGERS AS A STANDARD PART OF WATERSHED MANAGEMENT, RESTORATION, AND RISK ASSESSMENT EFFORTS. THIS PROJECT IS DESIGNED TO INCREASE THE EFFECTIVENESS AND NUMBER OF FUTURE ENVIRONMENTAL SCIENTISTS.  PARTICIPANTS WILL COLLABORATE AND WORK WITH FEDERAL SCIENTISTS AT A FEDERAL RESEARCH LABORATORY AND EXPERIENCE TRAINING RELATED TO ECOSYSTEM PROTECTION, GROUNDWATER AND SUBSURFACE PROCESSES, WATER RESOURCES, AND OTHER ENVIRONMENTAL RESEARCH TOPICS.  PARTICIPANTS WILL GAIN EXPERIENCE IN HYPOTHESIS FORMULATION, EXPERIMENTAL DESIGN AND SET-UP, SAMPLE ANALYSIS, DATA EVALUATION, QUALITY ASSURANCE, AND PRESENTATION AND PUBLICATION OF REPORTS AND RESULTS.

N-SINK IS A WEB TOOL TO SUPPORT COMMUNITY NUTRIENT AND LAND USE DECISIONS IN WATERSHEDS. THE WORK IS TO EXPAND THE TOOL AND DO PUBLIC OUTREACH TO SHOW HOW NUTRIENT RETENTION IN WATERSHEDS VARY WITH LAND COVER USING WITH COMMUNITY (CITY, STATE, LOCAL) PLANNERS, MANAGERS. THE PROJECT WILL WORK TO EXPANDED BEYOND THE GEOGRAPHIC AREA OF NEW ENGLAND TO THE NATION IF POSSIBLE. INDICATORS OF SUCCESSFUL EXPANSION INCLUDE INCLUSION OF WATERSHEDS OUTSIDE OF THE CURRENT WEB TOOL STUDY AREA, EXAMPLE HEAT MAPS OF NITROGEN RETENTION AND WORKSHOPS FOR WATERSHED DECISION MAKERS TO DEMONSTRATE THE TOOL.
